map.利用系数和维护系数怎么取？: How to pick UF and MF?
Utilization factor (UF) reflects the fraction of luminaire flux reaching the road; wide distribution and high-reflectance road take high values, commonly 0.3–0.5; maintenance factor (MF) reflects lumen depreciation and dust, LED often 0.7, sodium 0.6. Both linearly affect spacing.
map.为什么最终间距比照度算出来的小？: Why is the final spacing smaller than the illuminance-based one?
map.工具取\"照度要求\"与\"光束覆盖\"两者的较小值。若只按照度算，间距过大时灯: The tool takes the smaller of "illuminance requirement" and "beam coverage". If spacing follows illuminance only, too-large spacing causes dark spots under lamps, so the distribution angle also constrains it — which is also why uniformity drops.
